def solve(case):
    nodes = {n['id']: n for n in case['nodes']}
    children = {}

        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:

    required = set(case['required_symbols'])
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    removed = []
    # sort nodes by depth desc, then id asc
    sorted_nodes = sorted(case['nodes'], key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid == 'root' or n['symbol'] in required or not n['removable']:
            continue
        # check children retained
        child_retained = [c for c in children.get(nid, []) if c in retained]
        if child_retained:
            continue
        # check required symbols after removal
        # simulate removal by considering retained without nid
        temp_retained = retained - {nid}
        # gather symbols from temp_retained
        symbols_present = {nodes[rid]['symbol'] for rid in temp_retained}
        if required.issubset(symbols_present):
            # remove
            retained.remove(nid)
            removed.append(nid)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {'removed_node_ids': removed, 'retained_node_ids': retained_sorted}
